auth_methods.quote: Provide your API key as the basic auth username value. You don’t need to provide a password.
auth_methods.note: API key via HTTP Basic or Bearer header. Connect OAuth (for acting on connected accounts) excluded as not own-credentials; MCP agent keys are same class.

credential_access.quote: The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests.
credential_access.note: Free account; test-mode/sandbox keys immediately. Live mode requires account activation (business verification) but no fee.

production_gate.quote: You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data
production_gate.note: Users bring own API keys; no review needed. Stripe App Marketplace review (docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/publish-app) applies only to UI Stripe Apps; Connect OAuth is an alternative path. Arguably ambiguous.

api_type.quote: The Stripe API is organized around REST

mcp_official.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API

main_blocker_type.quote: The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests.
